title: Chapter 450
text:
The universe was vast, and new species were born at every moment. Finding the valuable parts of various plants and animals and refining them into medicine was a complicated and profound subject. This was especially so in the interstellar space where there were countless species. It required patience and the skill of time.

There were also many different ways to refine potions, such as chemical potions from the technological side, witchcraft potions from the magical side, and various other potion techniques.

There was an authoritative Pharmacist Association in the galaxy, just like the Spacetime Society. It was a platform for Pharmacists to communicate with each other, and it was also the easiest way for galactic residents to hire Pharmacists. As long as one logged into the Pharmacist Association's website, there would be online Pharmacist apprentices asking for clients' requests. This gave Han Xiao a sense of déjà vu.

After the matter at the space station came to an end, Han Xiao immediately contacted the Pharmacist Association and found a reliable pharmaceutical company in the Shattered Star Ring to make the Interstellar Beast potion. This company was located on a colonial planet of the Amethyst Civilization in the Colton Star Cluster.

Purple Crystal was one of the strongest civilizations in the entire Shattered Star Ring.

Godora was a Star System civilization, and there were a few Star System civilizations in the Colton Star Cluster. Godora of the Garton Star System, New Phylen of the Rain Star System, Holy Stone and Black Raven of the Fawn Star System … The Amethyst Civilization was a Star Cluster civilization that was one level higher, and their colonial planets were all over the various Star Clusters and Star Systems of the Shattered Star Ring.

The stable stargates near Juberly Hub that connected the different Star Systems of the Colton Star Cluster were jointly funded by the various Star Systems of the Colton Star Cluster and built by the Amethyst Civilization.

The level of Purple Crystal was too high, be it in terms of benefits or danger. Han Xiao did not plan to have any deep contact with them, as the risks would only far exceed the benefits. Thus, his only goal was to make the potion.

There were no obstacles in the process. Perhaps the Shattered Star Ring was more dangerous, but near the stronghold of a Star Cluster civilization, not many galactic pirates or scavengers dared to mess around. The range of a Star Cluster civilization's defense weapons was very long, and if they discovered bandits near a colonial planet, they would not even need to send out spaceships to chase after them. They could just fire on the planet and turn the wanted criminals into fireworks.

The pharmaceutical company that Han Xiao chose had a good reputation and was very high-end. It was a technology-oriented pharmaceutical company. After paying a certain fee, he waited for a few days and successfully obtained the medicine made from the Interstellar Beast's material. He did not encounter any problems.

Inside the machinery modification room of the spaceship, a portable freezer was placed on the table. The lid was opened, and inside the white mist, there were eight test tubes in total. Six were light purple, and two were deep indigo. The former was a gene medicine made from the important organs of the Interstellar Beast, and the latter was a special medicine made from its penis … No, it was a life crystal.

Han Xiao's finger brushed past the two potions, and two translucent light blue information bars popped up beside the objects, with the item introductions written on them.

[Interstellar Beast Medicine (High Concentration 62.0%)]: A precious medicine made from the genes of Interstellar Beasts. After consumption, attributes will be permanently increased. Effective Number of Uses: 0/3. Before drinking it, I want to warn you that the genes of Interstellar Beasts are not so easy to bear … Of course, if the mutated life form suits your taste, please feel free to drink it.

[Metabolism Adjustment Medicine]: A rare medicine made from the life core of Interstellar Beasts. After consumption, lifespan will be increased with almost no side effects. Life is like a summer flower that disappears in the blink of an eye. No amount of wealth or fame will be as insignificant as dust compared to it. Guess how many creatures will go crazy over this small bottle of medicine?

The lifespan increasing medicine did not have a limit on the number of times it could be used, so it would have no effect on players. Han Xiao played with the medicine and pondered.

"One Interstellar Beast is only condensed into eight bottles of medicine. The ratio is really scary. If I drink the lifespan medicine, will the interface show that my lifespan has increased? This attribute is not recorded on the interface. "

While pondering, Han Xiao did not slow down. He drank a bottle of lifespan medicine in one gulp. It tasted spicy, like a burning knife stabbing all the way from his throat to his stomach. The pain only lasted for a few seconds before it turned into a comfortable warmth that spread throughout his body. It was as if he was sitting next to a fire to warm his body.

Han Xiao was prepared to endure the pain, but he did not expect it to be so comfortable. He let out a long sigh and closed his eyes in enjoyment. His mind sank into his body and went beyond the five senses to experience the changes in every cell.

Countless creatures in the universe had a body, but very few people could completely control it. The soul was the master of the body, but it was also like the slave of the body. It had to eat, sleep, excrete, and so on to maintain the survival of the body. It could not actively turn off these functions. However, Han Xiao had a different feeling at this time. It was as if he could control every part of his body, not just the parts where the nerves were connected. As his thoughts turned, he realized that his cells were responding to his thoughts.

It was as if his body had become a precise machine. In the past, it was very difficult for him to control the operation of this machine, but now, he could slow down the operation of this machine …

"Increasing lifespan by controlling the metabolism. It really lives up to its name." Han Xiao stared at his palm. He could already control the speed of his metabolism. "Now, not only can I slow down my aging, I can even accelerate it. However, accelerating is an irreversible process. Delaying it is more important. I wonder how much my lifespan has increased …"

The lifespan of Supers was originally much longer than that of ordinary people. Coupled with the ability to control the metabolism, Han Xiao did not know how long his lifespan was.

"It feels like I can live for a very long time."

Han Xiao subconsciously pushed his nose up.

Looking at the interface, he saw that he had obtained a new skill.

You have learned the skill [Self-healing].

Han Xiaoxin thought to himself, The interface says that it's a self-healing skill, but the ability that the Life Potion gives me is far more than what the interface shows. Looks like the lifespan is a hidden bonus, or the interface only calculates the basic attributes.

The self-healing ability was not bad, and it gave him another layer of protection. However, Aurora's Character Summon Card was not used up yet, so Han Xiao probably would not use this skill in the short term.

There was only one Life Potion left, so Han Xiao stored it away. He could not guarantee that he would not use it in the future. He picked up another type of Gene Potion and injected three of them. He was already very familiar with Gene Potions. After the pain, he looked at the information on the interface. It gave him + 2 INT, + 6 END, and + 3 CHA.

"The bonus effect is not as high as the Void Dragon Marrow. After all, the Void Dragon is more than a thousand times stronger than the Interstellar Beasts. One is a dragon, while the other is a mayfly."

Han Xiao looked at his [Intermediate Strengthening Life] talent. After using the Void Dragon Marrow the last time, this talent had leveled up. This time, he had taken a rare creature's Gene Potion. According to his deduction, this talent should be strengthened again.

However, after a while, there were no other changes on the interface. Han Xiao was sure that the Molding Talent had not leveled up.

"Looks like one type of Gene Potion is not enough. Maybe the Interstellar Beast's species level has not reached the standard. If I want to level up from Intermediate to Advanced, I will need to use more Gene Potions. Hmm, but I can't abuse them."

He walked in front of the mirror. His appearance had not changed. The Interstellar Beast Potion did not cause any mutation. After using the Void Dragon Marrow the last time, he had become even more handsome than before.

He stored the rest of the potions. After putting away the box, Han Xiao sat in front of the table, took out a mission list, and fell into deep thought.

"There are still dozens of missions on the list, and these are only the missions that are suitable after my initial selection. I will not lack Random Rewards. The faster I complete the advancement, the earlier I can prepare for the main storyline of Version 2.0 …"

Han Xiao touched his chin and thought of the past. He missed the feeling of running around everywhere just to get what he wanted.

He thought about the mission itinerary again and confirmed that there were no mistakes.

"Hopefully, there will be enough time left for the version update after I successfully advance."

The sound of Herlous and the others playing cards could be heard outside the door. Fu Ding's singing could be vaguely heard from the other room. He was learning Chen Xing's techniques and training his psychic power through singing. However, Fu Ding was not Chen Xing after all. His high notes sounded like a pig being slaughtered.

Han Xiao shook his head, put on his earplugs, and took out a stack of papers that Sylvia was punishing to copy basic mechanical theory from the pile of books on the table. He quickly corrected them.
